name: Beat the Beast: Cerberus' Inferno
review:
The Beat the Beast series pits you against mythical monsters, and this one heads to the underworld. It's a 9-line game with stacked wilds, and the free spins bonus switches to 243 ways with retriggers.

That jump in ways is the whole point: the bonus plays very differently from the base game. Very high volatility, 6,666x cap, 96.15% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
